## Question 1
```{r}
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "../data/midwest_airbnb.db")
listings <- dbReadTable(con, "listings")
```

```{r}
nrow(listings)
```

## Question 2
```{r}
sum(listings$city == "Columbus")

# table(listings$city)
# can also do that to see all listings
```

## Question 3
```{r}
chicago <- listings[listings$city == "Chicago", ]
chicago[chicago$price == max(chicago$price), c("name", "price")]
```

## Question 4

```{r}
length(unique(listings$neighbourhood[listings$city == "Chicago"]))
```
